SELECT s.payer_class, count(*), round(median(date_diff('day',s.first_sub,r.payment_date)),1), round(quantile_cont(date_diff('day',s.first_sub,r.payment_date),0.9),1) FROM (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2) s JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT a.claim_key||'|'||a.payer_key) n FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id=a.remit_claim_id WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code='CO' AND a.is_denial_carc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1 LIMIT 5

SELECT payer_class, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE n=1 AND ok), round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE n=1 AND ok)/count(*),2) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) payer_class,count(*) n,bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT payer_class,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE rv),count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT cur),round(coalesce(sum(p),0),2) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) payer_class,count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) t,bool_or(is_reversal) rv,bool_or(is_current_adjudication) cur,sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) p FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) WHERE t>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

SELECT coalesce(round(sum(a.adjustment_amount),2),0) FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(remit_claim_id) JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P') p ON p.claim_key=r.claim_key AND p.payer_key=r.payer_key WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code='PR' AND a.carc_code='1'

WITH c AS (SELECT service_month m, referring_npi npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_date_from>=DATE '2026-06-01'), r AS (SELECT m,npi,count(*) n,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m ORDER BY count(*) DESC,npi) rk FROM c GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT strftime(m,'%Y-%m'),sum(n),sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5),round(100.0*sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5)/sum(n),1) FROM r GROUP BY m ORDER BY 1
SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code='87798')/sum(line_paid_amount),4) FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH x AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.procedure_code, r.remit_claim_id, r.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.claim_lines l ON l.claim_key=r.claim_key AND l.payer_key=r.payer_key AND l.is_latest_submission WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) SELECT procedure_code, round(avg(is_denied::INT),4), count(*) FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,CASE WHEN line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE line_count::VARCHAR END b,charge_amount ch FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility='P') SELECT b,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied),round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied)/count(*),2),coalesce(sum(ch) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied),0) FROM c JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB') SELECT a.reference_id,a.payment_date,round(abs(a.provider_adjustment_amount),2),min(b.payment_date),min(b.payment_date)-a.payment_date FROM f a LEFT JOIN f b ON b.payer_key=a.payer_key AND b.reference_id=a.reference_id AND b.provider_adjustment_amount=-a.provider_adjustment_amount AND b.payment_date>a.payment_date WHERE a.provider_adjustment_amount<0 GROUP BY a.provider_adjustment_id,a.reference_id,a.payment_date,a.provider_adjustment_amount ORDER BY 2,1

WITH s AS (SELECT payer_class,sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-07-01') j,sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month='2026-08-01') a FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1) SELECT payer_class,round(100*j/sum(j) OVER (),1),round(100*a/sum(a) OVER (),1),round(100*a/sum(a) OVER ()-100*j/sum(j) OVER (),1) FROM s ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='1') od,min(submission_date) FILTER (WHERE frequency_code='7') rd FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING rd IS NOT NULL), j AS (SELECT o.*,r.payment_date pd,r.paid_amount pa FROM o LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=o.claim_key AND r.payer_key=o.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.payment_date>=o.rd) SELECT count(*),round(avg(rd-od),2),count(pd),round(avg(pd-od),2),sum(pa) FROM j

WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key,min(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd)),count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd)),round(coalesce((SELECT sum(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE is_current_adjudication AND claim_key IN (SELECT claim_key FROM v)),0),2) FROM v

WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,any_value(payer_class) pc,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), f AS (SELECT c.pc,min(r.payment_date)-c.rd d FROM c JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.payment_date>=c.rd GROUP BY c.claim_key,c.payer_key,c.pc,c.rd) SELECT pc,count(*),round(avg(d),1),min(d),max(d) FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication))

WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) payer_class, min(submission_date) first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2) WHERE first_sub BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'), f AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(payment_date) fr FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT payer_class,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-first_sub<=14),round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fr-first_sub<=14)/count(*),1) FROM c LEFT JOIN f USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), d AS (SELECT c.* FROM c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=c.claim_key AND r.payer_key=c.payer_key AND r.claim_status_code='4' AND r.payment_date<c.rd)), o AS (SELECT d.*,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=d.claim_key AND r.payer_key=d.payer_key AND r.payment_date>=d.rd) af,cur.is_denied cd,coalesce(cur.paid_amount,0) p FROM d LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims cur ON cur.claim_key=d.claim_key AND cur.payer_key=d.payer_key AND cur.is_current_adjudication) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT af THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN cd IS FALSE THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END,count(*),round(sum(p),2) FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING bool_or(NOT is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied)) SELECT count(*),coalesce(round(sum(r.paid_amount),2),0) FROM p JOIN sem.remit_claims r USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND NOT r.is_denied
